best: The 3V3 buck and the USB four-switch power stage read as clean left-to-right power paths: input caps, switch/IC, inductor, output caps.
worst: Cells and Gauge sheet is fragmented: back-to-back protection FETs, the CHG/DSG gate resistors, fuse, Q104 and current-sense shunt are scattered islands tied only by labels, so the protection path and sense circuit are not recognisable
Auto-generated net names (Net-(U101-VC3), Net-(C313-Pad2), Net-(Q104-G)...) are used as labels everywhere, with the gauge cell-filter wiring crossing over itself to reach mis-ordered VC pins

Poor use of space and long wandering wires: 3V3 sheet crammed into the top strip, MCU antenna pi network split across the sheet (C314 far from C313/C315, value text on a wire), and charger nets (FB, FBG, CE_N, ACUV/ACOV) running long distances across the USB sheets
